include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# certutil.exe is all Rust (certutil-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/certutil-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# asn.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/certutil-rust/src/certutil/asn_cpp_h.rs)
# certutil.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/certutil-rust/src/certutil/certutil_cpp_h.rs)
# hashfile.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/certutil-rust/src/certutil/hashfile_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(certutil_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(certutil_shims PRIVATE conutils libcrypt32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
target_compile_definitions(certutil_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(certutil certutil-cargo certutil.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE certutil-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS certutil_shims xdk)
